messages:
Priya: quick sync — I uploaded a Cut Impact Matrix (drive) for the Nov 12 launch. please skim by EOD. main asks: which of these do we push to v1 vs cut from MVP? items called out: SSO full flow, embeddings-refresh background job, priority-routing rules, quota-alerting.

Liam: looked — my take: defer embeddings-refresh to v1. it's high infra risk and we can ship with a simple periodic refresh. saves ~2 sprint dev effort. :+1:

Evelyn: +1 on embeddings. for SSO we should trim to core auth + admin console later. customers care about SSO SAML first-run, but we can make some enterprise features opt-in for v1.

Marco: note: ACME pilot asked for priority-routing (to favor low-latency cheaper variants). if we cut it we lose pilot parity. can we do a canary with minimal rules?

Sam: technical constraints: priority-routing needs model-variant compatibility table + fallback logic. we can implement a limited rule set (by route tags) and default to fallback model. embeddings-refresh is isolated (batch job + cache); deferring is low customer-visible risk.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary pipeline created for branch `canary/priority-routing` — run window: 2026-01-09 03:00 UTC. logs will be in ci/canaries.

Priya: proposed resolution (quick):
- Move embeddings-refresh => v1 (owner: Sam)
- SSO: ship core SAML login + disable admin self-serve (defer advanced SSO to v1) (owner: Evelyn)
- Priority-routing: implement limited canary for pilot customers, gating on 99th P95 latency delta <= +30ms and error rate delta <= +0.3% (owner: Marco)
- Quota-alerting: keep basic alerts, defer fancy dashboards to v1 (owner: Liam)

Priya: acceptance criteria (short):
```
- SSO: SAML login passes smoke for 3 pilot orgs, no regressions in session expiry.
- Embeddings-refresh: background job present and documented, staleness <= 24h.
- Priority-routing canary: telemetry shows latency/error within gate for 48h.
```

Liam: question — what's our rollback window for the canary? need to reserve capacity if we hit hot-path.

Marco: propose 2-hour automatic rollback if error rate spikes above +0.5% or latency jumps > +100ms for 5m. manual kill otherwise.

Evelyn: I'll draft the customer comms for pilots and a short FAQ for SSO trimmed behaviors. posting PR tonight.

Sam: I'll scope the embeddings job and send a tiny runbook for on-call (how to force-refresh cache).

Priya: thanks all. I'll update the matrix with these decisions and owners, then mark the items with "MVP: trimmed" tags. final ask: owners, drop a quick :thumbsup: here once you confirm. deadline EOD PST.

Liam: :thumbsup:
Evelyn: :thumbsup:
Marco: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Priya: noted — closing sync in channel, will follow up with calendar invite for canary kickoff.
